name: Urukku Manush v2.2.0
changelog:
• Massive 65.7% APK size reduction (from 27.6 MB down to 9.4 MB) with optimized fonts, compressed audio, and R8 shrinking.
• Firebase Cloud Messaging: Instant push notifications when rivals beat your high score!
• Anti-cheat hardware-bound score vault (/data/data/) protecting high score integrity.
• Smooth progressive speed ramp (scores 3 -> 25 -> 50) and eliminated mid-gap oscillation traps.
• Offline play support with default character head and easy re-activation.
